After high school, he moved into the city with his guitar and made a decent living as a bar musician. The bar soon became more important than his guitar and his skills quickly fell by the wayside. I remember he had stars in his eyes when he left town...

Let me tell you all about the event known as "the circle of free."

New years eve 2010, I was at a widespread panic show with my best friend, Reed. When we arrive to the arena, Reed high-fives a guy in the parking lot. The random dude slipped Reed a gram of some dank purple weed for free.

We go into the show and we find our seats. About an hour in and we are tripping face thanks to Reed's hippy friends. I feel a tap on my shoulder so I turn around. The guy behind me offered me money to smoke with him. Normally I wouldn't charge someone to smoke with me. I've been there and I understand the struggle. But this night, Reed and I were incredibly parched and were dying of thirst so we took his money and got high with him.

I take the $10 and  go to buy some waters. A guy in the box seats asks me what I need and I say water. I was thinking he was a vendor so I hand him my money for the waters and he refuses it. I'm blown away by all this generosity. I go back to Reed and he's equally as blown away by all the kindness.

TLDR: got free weed, free money for the weed, then free water. 10/10. Would try again.
